lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured lattice of high-luminance circular spots organized into roughly parallel horizontal rows and vertical columns across the visible mid-section posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the spots, creating a rectangular grid-like pattern most visible in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular, dominant horizontal ridge running along the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge to a deep shadow gradient on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Three elongated, light-colored biological attachments (remoras) trailing from the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
